rationale: Chris brings simulation and robotics-simulation expertise as CTO at Zhavia Labs, while Jessie is a hardware test engineer working on robotics systems at Sesame AI—complementary perspectives on the same problem space. Their skills span the simulation-to-hardware gap, with Chris's typescript/python/rust stack and Jessie's hands-on testing experience potentially valuable for validating robotics designs across both simulation and physical systems.
intro_message: Chris Orlin Cardoza, meet Jessie Fan — you're both working on robotics from different angles (simulation vs. hardware testing) and could compare approaches to bridging that gap.
